symptom: i2cdetect returns a single device at 0x68 but my MPU6050 code reads all zeros

files.mpu.py:
from mpu6050 import MPU6050
sensor = MPU6050(address=0x69)
print(sensor.get_accel_data())

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the device at 0x68 (104) — that's the MPU6050's address. The code must be using the wrong address (probably the 0x69 default). Pass address=0x68.
